findings.description: `frequency + title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0` parses as `(frequency + title_bonus) if term in title_terms else 0.0`. Any body term that is not in the title gets a score of 0.0 instead of its frequency. When the title is empty (the default), every keyword scores 0.0 and ranking collapses to alphabetical order. In `suggest_tags`, 0.0 is below MIN_SCORE, so articles get no suggestions except for title terms.
findings.suggestion: Write `scores[term] = frequency + (title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0)`.
